source: IETF LAMPS working group composite test vectors (draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-kem and draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-sigs)
producer: The draft authors (lamps-wg GitHub repositories). Not a certification body: NIST ACVP has no composite family.
note: Vendored verbatim, byte-for-byte, no re-formatting (listed in .prettierignore). Each sha256 below is the hash of the upstream file at the pinned commit; the same files and hashes are pinned in the pqctoday-hsm engine repository (rust/kat/pkcs11-v33/PROVENANCE.md), and src/data/pkcs11-v33/vectorProvenance.test.ts fails if either copy drifts. These are single known-answer vectors per parameter set. Encapsulation and signing are randomised, so the vectors prove decapsulation and verification only. They predate the current drafts (composite-kem -23, composite-sigs -19); the OIDs, labels and signature prefix were compared with the current drafts on 2026-10-21 and are unchanged.
pkcs11_status: PKCS#11 v3.3 is an unpublished OASIS working draft. The composite identifiers are marked approved in the OASIS PKCS 11 TC header (github.com/oasis-tcs/pkcs11 commit 9ef73f9f44ed8a240b05484427a0851ab36be251, working/headers/pkcs11t.h). No OASIS v3.3 profile or test case exists.

composite-kem/testvectors.json.entries: 14: the 12 composite ML-KEM sets plus plain ML-KEM-768 and ML-KEM-1024. Fields tcId, ek, dk, dk_pkcs8, c, k, x5c (base64); top-level cacert.

composite-sig/testvectors.json.entries: 21: the 18 composite ML-DSA sets plus plain ML-DSA-44/65/87. Fields tcId, pk, sk, sk_pkcs8, s, sWithContext, x5c (base64); top-level message m and context ctx.
